description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy (%) of three different models—Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen2.5-Omni—on two types of input: Audio (solid blue bars) and Noise (solid purple bars), as evaluated on the MMAR benchmark for deep reasoning in speech, audio, and music. The vertical y-axis represents accuracy percentage, ranging from 0 to 60 in increments of 10, while the horizontal x-axis lists the three models. A dashed light blue horizontal line at approximately 30% appears to indicate a baseline or threshold. For Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio accuracy is ~30% and Noise accuracy is ~23%. For Audio-Reasoner, Audio accuracy rises to ~37% and Noise to ~30%. Qwen2.5-Omni shows the highest performance: Audio accuracy reaches ~57%, and Noise accuracy is ~36%. The legend in the top-left corner identifies the blue bars as “Audio,” purple bars as “Noise,” and the dashed line as an unlabeled reference (possibly “Baseline” or “Chance”). The chart visually emphasizes Qwen2.5-Omni’s superior performance across both modalities, particularly in audio understanding, while also showing that all models perform better on audio than on noise inputs.
